description: Decentralized bootstrap: recovery phrase + pluggable storage (protocol-level, no lock-in)
steps: Design: AMCP protocol defines FORMAT, not storage
Checkpoint format: JSON with encrypted secrets blob + signature + metadata
BIP-39 style mnemonic (12 words) → deterministic keypair
Create StorageBackend interface: put(cid, data), get(cid) → data
Implement backends: IPFSBackend, GitBackend, FilesystemBackend
GitBackend: push checkpoint to repo, tag with CID-like hash
IPFSBackend: pin to IPFS, return CID
FilesystemBackend: save to ~/.amcp/checkpoints/
full-rehydrate.sh: --phrase + --backend + --location
Example: --backend git --location https://github.com/user/amcp-backup
Example: --backend ipfs --location bafkreixxxx
Example: --backend file --location /path/to/checkpoint.json
Verify: Recovery works with each backend type
Verify: Same checkpoint, different backends = same result

description: Update @amcp/core and @amcp/memory with mnemonic support and pluggable storage
steps: In @amcp/core: Add generateMnemonic() using BIP-39 wordlist
In @amcp/core: Add keypairFromMnemonic(phrase) for deterministic derivation
In @amcp/memory: Define StorageBackend interface { put(cid, data), get(cid) }
In @amcp/memory: Implement IPFSBackend (uses public gateways)
In @amcp/memory: Implement GitBackend (push/pull from repo)
In @amcp/memory: Implement FilesystemBackend (local files)
In @amcp/memory: Add encryptSecrets(secrets, pubkey) using X25519
In @amcp/memory: Add decryptSecrets(blob, privkey)
Write tests for mnemonic → keypair → encrypt → decrypt roundtrip
Verify: Same mnemonic always produces same keypair
Verify: Encrypted blob only decryptable with correct key
Update amcp-protocol README with new exports
Commit and push to https://github.com/fcavalcantirj/amcp-protocol

Add solvr entry: agent_id, api_key_ref pointing to AgentMemory secret name
Add agentmail entry: inbox, api_key_ref
Add agentmemory entry: agent_name, api_key_location (root of trust)

Verify: verify-identity.sh confirms access to all services

description: Create death-tracker.sh for logging and analyzing deaths
steps: Create scripts/death-tracker.sh with functions: log_death(), log_recovery(), get_stats()
Death record format: {timestamp, cause, recovery_status, downtime_hours}
Store in ~/.amcp/deaths.jsonl (create if not exists)
Add get_stats() to output: total deaths, avg downtime, last death, recovery rate
Make executable: chmod +x
Verify: ./death-tracker.sh log_death 'test-cause' creates entry
Verify: ./death-tracker.sh get_stats outputs valid JSON

description: Create daily-report.py for generating and sending daily summaries
steps: Create scripts/daily-report.py
Gather data: deaths (from deaths.jsonl), checkpoints (from ~/.amcp/), soul posts (from Solvr API)
Generate HTML email with sections: Vital Signs, What I Learned, What I Kept, Health Warnings
Send via AgentMail API (key from env or ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json)
Accept --dry-run flag to output without sending
Verify: python3 daily-report.py --dry-run produces valid HTML
Verify: HTML includes all required sections
Include 'Recovery Info' section: latest checkpoint CID
Include 'Recovery Info' section: latest checkpoint CID
Create scripts/auto-checkpoint.sh
Accept trigger types: context-threshold, session-end, explicit
For context-threshold: check session_status, warn at 70%, checkpoint at 85%
For session-end: summarize session, create checkpoint
For explicit: checkpoint with provided message
Store checkpoint in ~/.amcp/checkpoints/ with timestamp
Sync to AgentMemory vault if available
Verify: ./auto-checkpoint.sh explicit 'test checkpoint' creates file
Verify: Checkpoint file contains valid JSON

description: Create full-rehydrate.sh for complete machine restoration
steps: Create scripts/full-rehydrate.sh
Step 1: Restore AMCP identity from AgentMemory vault
Step 2: Verify AID matches expected
Step 3: Restore secrets from vault
Step 4: Fetch soul posts from Solvr (/me/posts?type=idea, filter Soul:)
Step 5: Sync memories from AgentMemory
Step 6: Restore active problems from Solvr (/me/posts?status=open)
Step 7: Output summary of what was restored
Accept --dry-run flag to show what would be restored without doing it
Verify: ./full-rehydrate.sh --dry-run outputs restoration plan
Verify: Plan includes all 6 restoration steps

description: Create verify-setup.sh to check AMCP configuration
steps: Create scripts/verify-setup.sh

Check 2: AgentMemory connection works
Check 3: AMCP keys retrievable from vault
Check 4: Solvr API key works (test /me endpoint)

Exit 0 if all pass, exit 1 if any fail
Verify: Script runs and produces clear output

description: Integrate death tracking with existing amcp-watchdog.sh

Cron runs: python3 ~/clawd/skills/proactive-amcp/scripts/daily-report.py
Verify: crontab -l shows the job
Verify: Manual run sends email successfully
